verdict.rationale: HeyGen's documented Photo Avatar feature creates an avatar from a single still image of a person, animating the face and syncing lip movements to a script. That is a real but narrow form of still-to-motion animation, limited to talking human portraits rather than general image-to-video. Missing for 10: general image-to-video for arbitrary subjects and scenes, explicit evidence that subject and composition are preserved, and independent or hands-on corroboration of output fidelity.
